articles.title: Wall Street Could Boost Uniswap's Token Price Nearly 40x by 2030: Standard Chartered
articles.snippet: Uniswap’s native token UNI is set to surge nearly fortyfold in the coming years as Wall Street migrates on-chain, Standard Chartered said.

articles.title: How Crypto Firms Will Own the Octagon at Trump's White House UFC Event
articles.snippet: President Trump’s upcoming UFC fight will provide several crypto firms with an unprecedented opportunity for corporate branding.
